svg.title: RabTech Academy Task 02 — Trust Boundary Diagram
svg.desc: Trust boundary diagram identifying five boundaries: TB-01 (Assessment Host to LAB-01), TB-02 (Web Application to Training Database), TB-03 (User Input to Application Processing), TB-04 (Application to Privileged/Admin functionality), and TB-05 (Assessment Host through Host-Only Network to LAB-02). Each boundary explains why it matters and what controls exist.
svg.text: RabTech Academy — Task 02: Trust Boundary Diagram
Flask Application | Intentionally vulnerable | Testing target
username/pw | id (URL) | q= | author/content | session cookie
No validation / encoding — all deliberate vulnerabilities enter here
VULN [T-005]: session check only — no role==admin
Primary attack surface; all HTTP vulns here
Intended testing interface; all STRIDE categories
Only network path to LAB-02; prevents pivoting
SQL injection crosses here; plaintext passwords
All vulns originate from absent input validation
Vertical/horizontal priv esc — IDOR + broken authz
Session existence check only — no RBAC/ownership
TB-05 also applies to: Assessment Host → Host-Only Network → LAB-02 (network-level trust boundary)
